The fellowship

Four weeks. Twenty founders.

Launchpad is for students and early builders who already have something going: a working prototype, early user interviews, or an active side project. You don't need a registered company.

4 weeksFully online
20Founders per cohort, selected from applications
6–8 hrsExpected commitment per week
0%Equity taken, ever

  • Founder pods

    You work in a pod of 4–5 founders for the full four weeks.

  • Sunday Live Lab

    A live weekly session with the whole cohort.

  • 1:1 mentor office hours

    Time with mentors on your specific startup.

  • Demo Day

    Pitch at the end of the program, with intros to investors.

Free resource · no application needed

Start your investor list today

Every founder needs a target list before they pitch. Here are 2,244 funds with the stages and sectors they invest in and a partner to contact. Filter down to the ones that fit your startup.

Before you email anyone: most of these funds are US or global; 27 are based in or have an office in India. The list is compiled from Ramp's public fund database, so details can be out of date. Check the fund's website first, and only pitch funds that invest at your stage and in your sector.

Quick answers

Do I need a registered company?

No. A prototype, user interviews or an active side project is enough to apply.

When does the 5% apply?

Only when you raise from an investor TFC introduced you to, within 12 months of Demo Day. Nothing otherwise.

Is the investor list tied to the fellowship?

No. It's free for anyone. Launchpad is separate and needs an application.
